Cleveland Cavaliers.detail: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

Denver Nuggets.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Golden State Warriors.detail: Curry won't return to Wednesday's game against the Rockets due to right abdominal soreness, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports. He'll finish with three points (1-3 FG, 1-2 3Pt) across six minutes.
Payton (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against Houston.
Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Houston Rockets.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

Indiana Pacers.detail: Nesmith will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to right knee soreness. He'll finish with two points (1-6 FG, 0-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist across 22 minutes.
Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Los Angeles Lakers.detail: Doncic finished Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks with 32 points (10-25 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 7-10 FT), five rebounds, five assists and three steals across 32 minutes. He exited to the locker room late in the fourth quarter due to an apparent right ankle injury and did not return, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
Reaves will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks due to a left heel injury, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.
Sexton went back to the locker room during Wednesday's game against the Bucks after bumping heads with Ryan Rollins, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
Grimes (finger) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Milwaukee Bucks.detail: Rollins exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's game against the Lakers due to an apparent head injury, per the broadcast.
Turner has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers due to rest.

Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Utah Jazz.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
